title: Get back in with a linked account
summary: From recovery-start: the sign-in with the Apple or Google account that the person linked (ADR 0096). After it passes, recovery-pin asks for the PIN (factor linked); then recovery-waiting runs the 24-hour delay.

phase.description: signingIn: the nonce or web flow request and the provider sheet run. failed: shows error with a retry.

start.effect: iOS Apple: POST /v1/recovery/link/nonce, then the Sign in with Apple sheet with that nonce. Every other case: POST /v1/recovery/link/{provider}/web and the authorization URL in ASWebAuthenticationSession (iOS) or a Custom Tab (Android). The proof (the ID token, or flow_id and the handoff) stays in memory and recovery-pin opens with factor linked. A cancelled sheet goes back to recovery-start.

notes: The PIN comes last (ADR 0059). recovery-pin with factor linked sends POST /v1/recovery/link with the proof and the PIN; 201 keeps the RecoveryStarted and opens recovery-waiting with method apple or google.
recovery_invalid from POST /v1/recovery/link: the proof is bad or no Bipe account has that provider account linked. recovery-pin shows bipe_recovery_linked_invalid and goes back to recovery-start.
No PIN reset on this path (linkedRecovery.allowsPinReset false): forgotPin and pin_blocked show bipe_recovery_linked_pin_blocked and offer recovery-email.
Access only: recovery-waiting shows bipe_recovery_linked_history with the ready state.
